Download data from the BEA API

Source: R/fetch_bea.R
fetch_bea.Rd

Retrieves state series from the Bureau of Economic Analysis Regional accounts, or national series from the NIPA tables (used for price deflators).

Usage

fetch_bea(
  table,
  line_code,
  dataset = c("Regional", "NIPA"),
  states = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

table

BEA table name, for example "SAGDP9" or "T10109".

line_code

Line code (Regional) or line number (NIPA).

dataset

"Regional" (state data) or "NIPA" (national data).

states

States to keep (Regional only); NULL keeps all 50 + DC.

years

Years to keep; NULL keeps all available years.

api_key

BEA API key. Defaults to the BEA_API_KEY environment variable.

cache

Use the local download cache.

refresh

Ignore any cached copy and download again.

Value

A data frame with columns state (NA for NIPA data), year, series ("<table>:<line>"), value and unit. Values are in the units reported by BEA (the UNIT_MULT scale factor is already applied to the unit label, not the value).

Details

Useful Regional tables and line codes:

  • SAGDP9 line 1: real GDP, all industries (millions of chained 2017 dollars); line 12: manufacturing.

  • SAGDP2 line 1: nominal GDP (millions of current dollars).

  • SAINC1 line 1: personal income (millions of dollars); line 2: population (persons); line 3: per capita personal income (dollars).

Useful NIPA table: T10109 line 1, the implicit price deflator for GDP (index, 2017 = 100).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # nzchar(Sys.getenv("BEA_API_KEY"))
fetch_bea("SAGDP9", 1, states = "CA", years = 2015:2020)
fetch_bea("T10109", 1, dataset = "NIPA")
}
